terbaru.judul: A Survey on Rubric-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Language Models
terbaru.pelajaran: In this survey, we introduce a Bayesian framework that defines constitutions as prior distributions $P(R)$ over evaluation criteria and rubrics as conditional instantiations $R_x \sim P(R|x)$.

terbaru.judul: Lightweight AI for UAV-Mounted RIS: An Overview
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a detailed taxonomy and comparative analysis of existing work, highlight computational-energy trade-offs, and identify open research challenges for scalable, energy-efficient airborne intelligent surfaces.

terbaru.judul: Towards Reliable, Generalizable, and Specific In-Context Knowledge Editing via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose Multi-Objective In-context Knowledge Editing (MO-IKE), a multi-objective RL algorithm that formulates prompt construction for in-context knowledge editing as a Constrained Markov Decision Process.
We propose On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward (OPDVR), a simple yet effective method that seamlessly combines OPD and RLVR without adding any hyperparameters.

terbaru.judul: Ockhamareto: Pareto-Gated Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Concise Unit-Test Generation with Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce \textbf{Ockhamareto}, a single-shot GRPO framework for unit-test generation and selection, based on the principles of \emph{Ockham's Razor} and \emph{Pareto Optimality}.

terbaru.judul: Multi-Objective Deep Reinforcement Learning for Secure and Stable Power System Operation
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper develops a unified-control deep reinforcement learning agent that maintains thermal security under stochastic load variations while steering the system toward operating points with improved damping of the most critical mode.

terbaru.judul: Decoupling Policy Extraction for Offline Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: Offline RL methods commonly jointly train the actor and critic, where the critic is used to guide the actor toward higher-value actions.

terbaru.judul: SAPO: Single-Rollout Autoregressive Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we propose Single-rollout Autoregressive Policy Optimization (SAPO), an efficient PPO-style framework that unifies policy optimization and value learning within a single causal language model.

terbaru.judul: Debate Training Reduces Reward Hacking in RLAIF
terbaru.pelajaran: We demonstrate that RL finetuning an LLM using debate, a two-player adversarial game between a generator and a critic adjudicated by a weaker LLM judge, reduces reward hacking compared to a reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) baseline.

terbaru.judul: Agentic ESOpt: Fine-Tuning Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Minimal GPU Requirements
terbaru.pelajaran: Based on this insight, we propose Agentic ESOpt, a full-parameter agentic fine-tuning framework tailored to flexible parameter--context co-evolution.
